IRS990.MissionDesc: TO EDUCATE, ENCOURAGE AND EMPOWER GIRLS. OUR SCHOOL COMBINES ACADEMIC EXCELLENCE WITH AN APPRECIATION FOR CHILDHOOD SO THAT STUDENTS THRIVE AS LEARNERS, DEVELOP A STRONG SENSE OF SELF, CONTRIBUTE TO COMMUNITY, AND FULFILL THEIR POTENTIAL, NOW AND THROUGHOUT LIFE.
IRS990.Desc: EDUCATIONAL SERVICES FOR GIRLS AND YOUNG WOMEN IN KINDERGARTEN THROUGH EIGHTH GRADE. CURRENTLY, ENROLLED IN THE SCHOOL, GRADES KINDERGARTEN THROUGH EIGHTH, IS 400 STUDENTS.

BusinessName.BusinessNameLine1Txt: HINES BUILDING MAINT AND OPERATIONS MGMT

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SCHOOL INTENDS TO USE ITS ENDOWMENT EARNINGS TO SUPPORT ITS PROGRAMS. BURKE'S STRATEGIC PLAN, AVAILABLE ON ITS WEB SITE, STATES: "EXPERIENCE: READY TODAY, FOR TOMORROW: PROVIDE ACADEMIC PREPARATION THAT VALUES JOY AS MUCH AS ACADEMIC RIGOR AND IS DISTINGUISHED BY A FOCUS ON REAL-WORLD PROBLEMS, PURPOSE, LIFE SKILLS, AND HABITS OF MIND. CONNECTION: CARING FOR OUR COMMUNITY AND PLANET: CREATE GRADUATES WHO CARE DEEPLY FOR THEIR COMMUNITIES AND PLANET, EMBRACE DIFFERENCES AND BELONGING, WORK TO SUSTAIN THEIR NATURAL ENVIRONMENT, AND INSPIRE THEIR COMMUNITIES TO JOIN THEM. GROWTH: FOR THE COMMUNITY AND INSTITUTION: ENSURE FINANCIAL SUSTAINABILITY FOR THE INSTITUTION, AFFORDABILITY FOR FAMILIES, AND MEANINGFUL COMPENSATION FOR FACULTY AND STAFF."

THE SCHOOL IS A TAX-EXEMPT ORGANIZATION UNDER INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE CODE SECTION 501(C)(3) AND SIMILAR PROVISIONS OF THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE. MANAGEMENT EVALUATED THE SCHOOL'S TAX POSITIONS AND CONCLUDED THAT THE SCHOOL HAD MAINTAINED ITS TAX-EXEMPT STATUS AND HAD TAKEN NO UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS THAT REQUIRED ADJUSTMENT TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. THEREFORE, NO PROVISION OR LIABILITY FOR INCOME TAXES HAS BEEN INCLUDED IN THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS.
THE NON-DISCRIMINATORY NOTICE IS PUBLISHED ON THE SCHOOL'S WEBSITE.

KATHERINE DELMAR BURKE SCHOOL OFFERS NEED-BASED FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE. NEED-BASED FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE IS THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN A FAMILY'S RESOURCES AND THE COST OF A STUDENT'S EDUCATIONAL EXPENSES. BURKE'S AND OTHER INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS USE THE PARENTS' FINANCIAL STATEMENT (PFS) FROM THE TADS (TUITION AID DATA SERVICES) TO PERFORM A STANDARDIZED CALCULATION TO DETERMINE NEED. RECORDS ARE MAINTAINED ON ALL FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE APPLICATIONS AND FUNDS AWARDED TO STUDENTS.

THE SCHOOL HAS A HOUSE SPECIFICALLY FOR THE PURPOSE OF PROVIDING HOUSING FOR THE HEAD OF SCHOOL. THE HEAD OF SCHOOL IS REQUIRED TO USE THIS HOUSE FOR ENTERTAINING BOARD MEMBERS, EMPLOYEES, ALUMNI, AND DONORS OF THE SCHOOL. HER PERSONAL USE OF THE PROPERTY IS REPORTED AS TAXABLE INCOME EACH YEAR BASED ON AN ANNUAL ASSESSMENT OF THE PROPERTY'S FAIR MARKET VALUE. THE HEAD OF SCHOOL HAS AN EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT WHICH PROVIDES FOR GROSSED-UP TUITION REIMBURSEMENT PAYMENTS AND A RESIDENCE FOR PERSONAL USE.
THE NUMBER REFLECTS THE NUMBER OF ITEMS CONTRIBUTED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE DIRECTOR OF FINANCE AND OPERATIONS FOWARD A COMPLETE COPY OF THE FORM 990 TO THE TREASURER OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES AND THE HEAD OF SCHOOL FOR THEIR REVIEW PRIOR TO FILING. ANY QUESTIONS ARE ADDRESSED BY THE DIRECTOR OF FINANCE AND OPERATIONS AND/OR THE ACCOUNTING FIRM. QUESTION 11A OF PART VI IS MARKED "NO". THE FORM 990 REVIEWED AND APPROVED BY EACH BOARD MEMBER DURING THE ANNUAL PROCESS DID NOT HAVE THE SCHEDULE B DUE TO THE SENSITIVITY OF THE INFORMATION ON THE SCHEDULE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: COMPLIANCE WITH THE SCHOOL'S CONFILICT OF INTEREST POLICY IS MONITORED AND REVIEWED BY THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES. POLICY IS APPLIED TO ALL TRUSTEES AND EMPLOYEES. EACH VOTING MEMBER OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES COMPLETES AN ANNUAL CONFLICT OF INTEREST DISCLOSURE. CONFLICTS ARE DISCUSSED WITH THE COMMITTEE CHAIR OR EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE. CONFLICTS ARISING FROM DISCLOSURE REQUIREMENTS ARE DOCUMENTED ON THE DISCLOSURE FORM. INDIVIDUALS WITH CONFLICTS ARE RECUSED FROM VOTING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: COMPENSATION TO THE HEAD OF SCHOOL AND OTHER KEY MANAGEMENT EMPLOYEES IS BENCHMARKED TO OTHER K-8 INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS OF SIMILAR SIZE IN THE SAN FRANCISCO BAY AREA. DATA IS USED FROM THREE SOURCES: (1) FEDERAL FORM 990 (2) STATISTICS FROM NAIS (NATIONAL ASSOCIATION OF INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS) (3) STATISTICS FROM ISBOA (INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS BUSINESS OFFICERS ASSOCIATION). THE BOARD PERFORMS A FORMAL ASSESSMENT OF THE HEAD'S PERFORMANCE ANNUALLY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SCHOOL MAKES ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, AND FORM 990 (PUBLIC VERSION) AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST FOR THE SAME PERIOD OF TIME SET FORTH IN SEC 6104(D).
